svg.title: Figure 3.3 - the placement head
svg.desc: Constant-input logit surfaces for a replica transposed-convolution head and the shipped head; Fireball placement with and without the full-resolution branch.
svg.text: The period-4 bias, and what the full-resolution branch adds
Measured: shipped head from model_weights_live.pth (ep 115,173); replica = the pre-2026-08-09 design, random init
Same constant input and context to both; colour = deviation from the
map's mean, blue below, red above. The shipped head's border cells see
zero padding; its interior (rows 4-29, columns 4-13) is exactly flat.
(b) Fireball placement on one real board
Seed 6, tick 1810. Rings = enemy troops; band = river;
darker = more probability; own back row at the bottom. Zeroing the
branch is an ablation of a net trained with both paths.
